Coastal, city or mountain weekend for two?

Illustrative estimates, not live prices Costs are sample two-night totals for two people; travel hours are sample one-way times from a home base. Replace them with your own numbers before deciding.

Move the sliders to score the three options.

  • Coastal—
    Sample cost $620 · travel 2.5 h · beach walks, seafood, sunsets
  • City—
    Sample cost $780 · travel 1 h · museums, restaurants, late nights
  • Mountain—
    Sample cost $540 · travel 3.5 h · hiking, cabins, quiet

How the recommendation changes: each option gets a cost score and a travel score between 0 and 100 (100 = best of the three, 0 = worst). The overall score is the weighted average of the two using your sliders. Push “budget” up and the cheapest option (Mountain) rises; push “short travel” up and the closest option (City) rises; Coastal wins when the two weights are balanced because it is second-best on both.
